In [[3643 BBY]], on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Separatist War]], a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|promising]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|Commando]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the famous [[Havoc Squad]] was assigned by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Harron Tavus]], to '''retrieve''' intelligence on the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatists]], from the Republic [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Bellis]], in a Separatist-controlled [[Talloran village|village]]. The Sergeant complied and after infiltrating the village, leaving behind several Separatist corpses, the commando discovered that Bellis had been murdered previously and the agent's field box was nowhere to be found. The Sergeant was contacted by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Aric Jorgan]] who told the Commando to recover the Bellis' field box from his [[Bellis's house|house]]. The Sergeant did so and acquired the field box with the needed intelligence from Bellis' [[Lin|wife]], leaving the village afterwards.<ref name="TS" />
